7221.title: Deferred scroll compensation hides prepended history
7221.rootCauseOneLine: Touch/activity deferral keeps prepend compensation in a CSS transform, leaving older loaded rows above the native scroll origin.

prReviews.verdict: Static direction matches cause; not runtime verified
prReviews.topFinding: Real WKWebView in-bounds writes and bounce transitions remain unverified; no PR branch executed.

7221.proposedFix: Distinguish unsafe overscroll settling from ordinary in-bounds gestures, preserving the reading anchor while making loaded history natively reachable.
7221.caveats: Twice reproduced on trusted main in a controller regression and native Chromium layout, not on a real iOS device. Existing open PR 7222 prevents duplicate fix work.
